why: The palette is accepted, applied and published, and what reaches storage is always Classic, so the choice lasts exactly as long as the tab (issue #1058; modelled on settings-serializer-writes-the-default-quality-preset). Within a session everything looks right: the toggle moves, the next match honours it. The player who needs High contrast finds Classic again after every reload.
killedBy: createPlayerSettingsStore: defaults and persistence round-trips EVERY field through a fresh construction
parseSettingsPayload: stored data round-trips its own serialiser exactly
